d:
Revisit the best moments from Ghost Adventures Season 10 as Zak Bagans and his crew investigate haunted locations, unexplained sounds and chilling encounters. From strange evidence to unsettling experiences, each investigation raises new questions about what might be lurking in the darkness.
How much can the team uncover when they revisit these unforgettable paranormal investigations?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 10, Episodes 7, 3, 2, 10, 11, 4 and 13, on Discovery Channel India.
